original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚建筑行业委员会因极端高温呼吁暂停午间施工
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚建筑行业技能委员会要求建筑公司和房地产开发商暂停中午至下午3时30分之间的非必要重体力户外作业，并强制安排休息和补水时间，以保护工人免受极端高温影响。该委员会警告称，气温上升、持续干旱、沙尘天气和突发洪水使建筑工人面临中暑、呼吸系统疾病和工作场所事故风险。该建议由委员会主席Samson Opaluwah签署，属全国性安全提示。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚建筑行业技能委员会要求建筑公司暂停中午至下午3时30分之间的非必要重体力户外作业
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Sector Skills Council for Building in Nigeria has directed construction companies and property developers to suspend non-essential heavy outdoor work between noon and 3:30 pm

key_facts.fact: 委员会要求承包商调整工时、提供饮用水并设立遮阳休息区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the council directed contractors to restructure working hours, provide adequate drinking water and establish shaded resting areas at construction sites across the country

key_facts.fact: 该建议由委员会主席Samson Opaluwah签署，属全国性安全提示
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The advisory, signed by the council’s President, Samson Opaluwah

key_facts.fact: 委员会警告高温、干旱、沙尘和洪水使工人面临中暑、呼吸系统疾病和事故风险
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: rising temperatures, prolonged dry spells, dusty conditions and flash flooding were exposing construction workers to heatstroke, respiratory illnesses and workplace accidents

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
该建议的实际执行情况尚未获确认
